name: A drawn planetarium: the ticket office door stays shut until the player opens it by hand, then lets them in

designStructure.title: Late Show at Calder Planetarium
designStructure.premise: The volunteers of a small-town planetarium rehearse the autumn sky show for a school visit while a storm rattles the dome.
designStructure.opening: Doors open at eight. The projector lamp is new and nobody has tested it yet.

relationships.detail: They catalogued damaged exhibits together before the evacuation.

checks.name: The latched door keeps the player out of the office
The door is latched until it is used
Using the door by hand releases its latch
The player walks through the opened door into the office
The drawn building keeps its shell, stairs and portals
